items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: And then we used to play together with different bands and all.

ctx.x: He used to play with MS Lawyers. He played with them until they broke up the band. And then we used to play together with different bands and all. Tell him John Joseph is at 2811 Washington Avenue. He said John Joseph is at 2811 Washington Avenue. Washington, what? 2811. Oh, 2811. That's, uh, uh, Willis. Willis. Willis, uh, Clive, somebody back there. Yeah. Yeah, it's Willis and Clive. Uh, uh, uh. Ask him to make it. He better state ever since I know them. First and Liberty. He said I was like the headquarters.…
Ask him, did Big Kato have any?
